text:
alex: Noticing intermittent silent disconnects on long SSEs after the routing policy change for overflow pools in ap-south. Clients get no close, resume fails with missing last_event_id.
priya: saw a small spike at 03:21 UTC. Quick curl repro shows server sends FIN right after a route-swap.
alex: repro:
```
curl -v -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?resume=true&pool=overflow'
```
jon: root cause theory: new routing fence toggles keepalive suppression to reclaim sockets, but we aren't flushing the pending event id to the resume token during handoff. Proxy then closes silently.
priya: two short fixes: revert suppress-keepalive on overflow, or emit an SSE comment/ping just before swap. Revert is heavy. Emitting comment seems low-risk.
alex: let's try comment flush first. Add header `X-Flush-Event: 1` to gate in canary. Also add metric `stream.handoff.missing_last_event` and a tiny dashboard tile.
ops-bot: deploy: canary paused on ap-south-1 at 1750001150 by @alex.
jon: I'll add the metric and proxy log `hand-off: flushed_last_event=true/false`. Also add token timestamp check to avoid clients retrying forever with stale resume tokens.
priya: agreed. Rollout plan: patch + metric + gated header rollout tonight. If drop rate doesn't improve, revert routing fence on overflow.
alex: thanks — please post grafana snapshot when the metric lands. :thumbsup:
